long_biography.plain_text:
Atanas Ivanov Petrov's rise is rooted in the post-privatization growth of Vinprom Peshtera, where he and business partner Anton Shterev were identified as founders of the privately controlled producer. The enterprise developed proprietary labels, expanded manufacturing capacity and later adopted the VP Brands International name. Petrov subsequently consolidated substantial interests under Orbias, creating a distinct ownership vehicle for his share of their ventures.

That structure now links Petrov to several business lines. Orbias holds the larger share of Galaxy, a company that acquires, develops, leases and manages hotel, residential, office, retail and industrial assets. It also participates alongside Shterev's Solater in solar generation. The result is a portfolio that moved beyond its drinks-industry base without abandoning it, combining continuing ownership of an industrial producer with long-term property and infrastructure investments.

uncertainties.detail: The authoritative input assigns Felicity to person 9289. A public registry-derived record connects FT Boat to Galaxy Investment Group, current company data connects Galaxy to Orbias and Solater, and official regulator records identify Orbias's sole owner as Atanas Ivanov Petrov. No reviewed public page independently names Felicity's natural-person beneficial owner, so the vessel bridge remains anchored partly in the immutable source record.

Official regulator records assign Orbias solely to Atanas Ivanov Petrov and Solater solely to Anton Shterev. This dossier uses only Atanas's full patronymic and Orbias ownership. It does not copy Anton's patronymic, Solater ownership or any partner-only claim, even where joint companies are discussed.

Forbes-first exact-name and company searches found no dedicated personal profile for this Bulgarian entrepreneur. Search results for the same name include a Bulgarian volleyball coach and other namesakes; none was transferred into this record.

Business reporting repeatedly calls Petrov a founder of the private spirits producer, supporting Self-made. Reliable sources do not disclose his family background, education, acquisition financing or the precise mechanics by which the formerly state-era producer entered private hands, so the origin score remains below very high.

Orbias-linked interests are substantial in beverages, property and solar generation. Public sources do not reveal Petrov's full private balance sheet or establish one sector as his dominant current personal asset, so Diversified is more defensible than assigning property or manufacturing alone.

No strong reviewed source established a birth date, birthplace, education, early employment or family background. Those details are not inferred. The biography therefore concentrates on the durable, well-supported business arc and ownership structure.

Focused searches did not establish a dedicated personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube, TikTok, Wikipedia page or personal website above the verification threshold. The official Galaxy website is proposed only as a company website.

The biographies omit the vessel, current ownership percentages, project capacities, company financials, product lists, political allegations, disputes and source references. No live or compiled change is authorised.
